mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_processing_log( application_id, request_id, process_type, process_status, error_code, error_message, created_at ) VALUES ( #{applicationId}, #{requestId}, #{processType}, #{processStatus}, #{errorCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select:
SELECT lpl.log_id, lpl.application_id, la.member_id, m.name AS member_name, lp.product_name, lpl.process_type, lpl.process_status, lpl.created_at
FROM loan_processing_log lpl INNER JOIN loan_application la ON lpl.application_id = la.application_id
INNER JOIN member m ON la.member_id = m.member_id
INNER JOIN loan_product lp ON la.product_id = lp.product_id
ORDER BY lpl.created_at DESC, lpl.log_id DESC

SELECT lpl.log_id, lpl.application_id, lpl.request_id,
la.member_id, m.name AS member_name,
la.product_id, lp.product_name,
lpl.process_type, lpl.process_status,
lpl.error_code, lpl.error_message,
lpl.created_at
FROM loan_processing_log lpl
INNER JOIN loan_application la ON lpl.application_id = la.application_id
INNER JOIN member m ON la.member_id = m.member_id
INNER JOIN loan_product lp ON la.product_id = lp.product_id
WHERE lpl.log_id = #{logId}
